reference.review_consensus: Reviewers mostly praise Mungo's Italian Eatery in Collinsville as a cozy, family-owned spot with attentive staff like Maddie, Jose, and Sean. The signature Mungo's salad and house dressing are the top recommendation, alongside Beef or Steak Tony, tortellini, ravioli, spaghetti with a large meatball, carbonara, chicken dishes, scallops, Lamb Marsala, lobster castiglioni, and bread with garlic-basil olive oil dip. Opinions split on the red sauce: one diner likes its slight sweetness, while another found the pasta and salad overly sweet and preferred the garlic-bread bacon cheeseburger. Critics call the food overpriced, citing mediocre Chicken Parmesan, oily meat sauce, soggy zucchini, salty Brussels sprouts, poor Bananas Foster, a $14 salad charge, and missing takeout sides. Two one-star reviews also allege rude owner responses about outdated directions and an egg allergy, plus a rude waiter and a group of eight turned away.
